{{Quote|The Sanguinus Veil... Her crimson color resonates across Ord Mantell space, bespeaking her lust for war and hatred. Her miasma blankets the horizon, suffocating the hope and the light of our enemies. She alone represents the blood that will be shed by the hand of the Black Sun elite.|A [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] poet|<ref name="SWG:TTTFB">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other|Journal Entry: "The Trinity: The Final Battle"}}</ref>}}
The '''Sanguinus Veil Nebula''' was a [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] located in the [[Bright Jewel system/Legends|Bright Jewel system]].<ref name="SWG:PBJR" /> It had a crimson color<ref name="SWG:DE">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Darkveil Eclipse|Tansarii Point Station}}</ref> and surrounded the [[Scarlet Dawn]] quadrant.<ref name="SWG:PBJR" />
